test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Please read the information given below and answer the question

Six friends (A, B, C, D, E, F) are playing a game together, in which all are facing the center. E is to the left of D. C is between A and B. F is between E and A.

Who among the following is between D and F?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• C is between A and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14ffef5da2250a0aa8b5a816690ba6797aa7820d7229d860b84172776738301.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b33a6b8d69164e927e71744781bf32d05831c9ed07adafdcd20cd5193f4ed371.png] 

 
• F is between E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f7e8fbb3026c2b0ea051a21983d6e8eb3eac5d586e9e1f83e8dc636b574862.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c693d8f2583711367404bd59e29f46554ac243e2d2b3d623ab2763d0a680133e.png] 

 
• E is to the left of D. Due to this case 1 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a974bdede787f930d938b638d059422138e00057d0e122dafd5b9902cab235cb.png] 

 
• Thus, E is between D and F.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
